name: Chao canh ca tram
summary: A bowl of cháo canh made with Son River grass carp. The fish gives it a light sweetness, with mild heat from chili and fragrant seasoning.
origin: Phong Nha, made with grass carp from the Son.
taste: Lightly sweet from the fish, with mild heat from chili and fragrant seasoning.
seoTitle: Chao canh ca tram — Son River carp bowl
seoDescription: Cháo canh cá trắm is a Phong Nha bowl of Son River grass carp, lightly sweet from the fish with a mild chili heat.
